#PROJECT
PR:PROJECT_TITLE                 	Fecal metabolome of Guangzhou Nutrition and Health Study (GNHS)
PR:PROJECT_TYPE                  	Observational study
PR:PROJECT_SUMMARY               	Our study was based on the Guangzhou Nutrition and Health Study (GNHS). This
PR:PROJECT_SUMMARY               	study aims to investigate the relationships among human nutrition, environmental
PR:PROJECT_SUMMARY               	factors, gut microbiome and human diseases.The data from the control arm of a
PR:PROJECT_SUMMARY               	case-control study for hip fraction was also included in this project to
PR:PROJECT_SUMMARY               	replicate our findings.
PR:INSTITUTE                     	Westlake University

PR:ADDRESS                       	Zhejiang, 310000, China

#STUDY
ST:STUDY_TITLE                   	Guangzhou Nutrition and Health Study (GNHS)
ST:STUDY_TYPE                    	Observational study
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	The GNHS was an onging community-based prospective cohort study.In GNHS,a total
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	of 4,048 Chinese participants aged 40-75 years living in the urban area of
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	Guangzhou, China, for at least 5 years were recruited between 2008-2013.
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	Participants were followed up every three years. During the period 2008-2019,
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	blood samples were collected at up to three time points. In 2014-2019 follow-up
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	visits, stool samples were collected at up to two time points.The information of
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	diet, sociodemographic factors, lifestyle factors, and medications, etc. was
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	collected at the baseline and follow-up visits. The aim of this study was to
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	investigate the relationships among human nutrition, enviromental factors, gut
ST:STUDY_SUMMARY                 	microbiome and human diseases.
ST:INSTITUTE                     	Westlake University
ST:LAST_NAME                     	Ju-Sheng
ST:FIRST_NAME                    	Zheng
ST:ADDRESS                       	Westlake University,18 Shilongshan Rd, Cloud Town, Hangzhou, China
ST:EMAIL                         	zhengjusheng@westlake.edu.cn
ST:PHONE                         	+8657186915303

#COLLECTION

#TREATMENT

#SAMPLEPREP
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	The order of all test samples is randomly selected before the preparation. 10 mg
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	lyophilized feces were homogenized with 25μL water and extracted with 185μL
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	cold ACN-Methanol (8/2, v/v). After centrifugation, 30 μL supernatant was used
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	to derivatization with 20 μL freshly prepared derivative reagents on a Biomek
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	4000 workstation (Biomek 4000, Beckman Coulter, Inc., Brea, California, USA),
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	followed by mixing with internal standards. Subsequently, the derivatized
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	samples and serial dilutions of derivatized stock standards were randomly
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	analyzed and quantitated by an ultra-performance liquid chromatography coupled
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	to tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) system (ACQUITY UPLC-Xevo TQ-S, Waters
SP:SAMPLEPREP_SUMMARY            	Corp., Milford, MA, USA).
